Hair shape, unclipped face, finger curl, reflected limbs, actual arch, continuous clothed abdomen and joint guide motion reviewed.

developmentCorrections: Package geometry checksums use the same canonical JavaScript numeric serialization as the producer; Python exponent formatting differed for small rig values.
Split native mesh generation by joint ownership so touching blocks retain separate moving boundaries and far mode never merges across joints.
Child hair keeps independent head-width clearance instead of scaling the adult shell uniformly; swept side strands moved clear of the scalp.
Foot nail blocks lowered into their toe surfaces to remove submillimetre gaps from grid quantization.
Finger and thumb nails placed on the dorsal surfaces; grip socket moved to the tested fifteen-millimetre author gauge clearance.

Pregnancy slot removes original continuous torso middle and both native markers inside that interval; original body remains separately retained. The final abdomen scene was generated through real MCP after this correction; unfinished screenshot scenes were resumed serially after one documented software WebGL timeout.
limitations: Technical candidates; human art acceptance zero.
Original actor source, dimensions, protected clearance, face atlas and original skeleton/controllers are unavailable.
Real manual rigid skin binding is implemented; soft deformation weights, IK, motion clips and game integration are not.
All character surfaces are noncollision, including metal and guide components.
Head/ear/eye hair tests cover adult066 and school068, yaw -60/0/+60 and bounded standing/lowered shoulder frames, not all poses or clothes.

Clothed pregnancy replacement does not infer trimester or implement growth.
Software WebGL evidence is not hardware frame-rate acceptance.
